 Highs stay in the 60s through Sunday.
 Advertisement Updated: 6:10 PM EST Nov 18, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Mike Harvey Chief Meteorologist High temps in the 60's through the weekend
 Highs stay in the 60s through Sunday.
 Updated: 6:10 PM EST Nov 18, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Mike Harvey Chief Meteorologist PITTSBURGH — High pressure equals sunshine and warm temperatures through the weekend.
 Mornings Fog, Sunny Afternoons
 Areas of fog will reduce visibility across portions of the region, Thursday morning. Morning temperatures will be near freezing in most neighborhoods. Fog will gradually lift, giving way to sunshine and warm temperatures. 
 Advertisement Mild For Light Up Night
 Hearst Owned A very warm Saturday for Light Up Night in downtown Pittsburgh. The Holiday Market kicks off on Friday and Light Up Night on Saturday. It will be very mild for this time of year. We are expecting quiet and calm conditions to start the holiday season. Temperatures will be in the 50s Saturday night after a daytime high in the mid 60s. The normal high temperature for this time of year is 49°.
 Rain showers will return likely early Monday and bring more seasonal temperatures as we start Thanksgiving week. Rain showers look to be light.
 Hearst Owned Ample sunshine to end the week with highs in the 60s. We turn more seasonal as we approach Thanksgiving. 
OVERNIGHT: Mostly clear and cold with patchy fog late. Low: 30°.
THURSDAY: Patchy morning river valley fog, then sunny and warmer. High: 63°, low: 35°.
FRIDAY: Sunny and pleasant. High: 63°, low: 36°.
SATURDAY: Partly cloudy and comfortable. High: 65°, low: 42°.
